en.bdb: With loving devotion, all is futile
Millions of spiritualists and emperors confuse the public.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਲਖ ਰਾਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: jog bhog lakh raeh sa(n)g chalaavahee|

en.bdb: Millions adopt yoga and bhog (enjoyment) simultaneously

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: dheen dhunee asagaeh haath na paavahee|

en.bdb: But they cannot fathom the divine who is beyond all the religions and the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)t na sifat salaeh aakh sunaavahee|

en.bdb: But their praises and eulogies cannot know his extent.
All standing at His court adore that anxiety-free Lord.
